title.justification: The title of the paper is directly mentioned multiple times in the provided text, including in running headers and at the start of multiple sections.
title.quote: Predicting COVID-19 Pneumonia Severity on Chest X-ray with Deep Learning

analysis.description: This paper presents a model to predict the severity of COVID-19 pneumonia using chest X-ray images. The study focuses on creating a severity score prediction model utilizing pre-trained neural networks to quantify lung involvement and opacity, aiding in patient care decisions.

type.justification: The paper details the use of a dataset and trained models to predict COVID-19 pneumonia severity, providing quantitative results and analysis of the model's performance.
type.quote: Results: This study finds that training a regression model on a subset of the outputs from an this pre-trained chest X-ray model predicts our geographic extent score...

name.justification: The research is focused on analyzing and predicting disease severity from chest X-ray images, a subset of Medical Imaging.
name.quote: Chest X-rays provide a non-invasive (potentially bedside) tool to monitor the progression of the disease.

name.justification: The paper deals with the analysis and prediction from images using a neural network model, which is a core application of Computer Vision.
name.quote: In this study, we present a severity score prediction model for COVID-19 pneumonia for frontal chest X-ray images.

name.justification: The application of the research is directly related to predicting and managing health care for COVID-19 patients.
